 Hyderabad Massive Fire Breaks Out At Nayan Infra Apartments Four Fire Engines Deployed 
 Hyderabad: Massive fire breaks out at Nayan Infra Apartments, four fire engines deployed
 A massive fire broke out at Nayan Infra Apartments in Pet Basheerabad on Wednesday, triggering explosions involving gas cylinders and AC compressors in two flats. Four fire engines were deployed to control the blaze. Extensive property damage was reported
 By 
 Telangana Today 
 Published Date - 18 November 2026, 02:46 PM 
 Representational Image 
 Hyderabad : A massive fire broke out at Nayan Infra Apartments in Pet Basheerabad on Wednesday afternoon, triggering panic among residents.
 According to preliminary information, the fire reportedly originated from a lamp lit at the place of worship inside one of the flats. The flames quickly spread through the apartment, triggering a series of explosions.
 Gas cylinders and air-conditioner compressors in two flats located opposite each other on the fourth floor reportedly exploded, intensifying the blaze. The explosions caused extensive damage to the flats and heightened concerns among residents.
 On receiving information, four fire engines were rushed to the spot. Firefighters brought the flames under control and took measures to prevent the fire from spreading to other parts of the apartment building.
 Extensive property damage has been reported.
 Pet Basheerabad police are investigating the incident.
